description: The most complete read an agent can get on a food list. Call this before you plan, comment on, substitute or improve a grocery list, cart, order, menu or recipe, and before a human approves one. Send up to 50 ingredient names. Returns one fact-based, human-approved read of the whole cart: the health labels it carries, the total carbon and water, the balance across food groups with what to add, the flavor and texture it carries with the gap in each, and the diets it suits. It also returns swaps that keep flavor and texture. It returns a cook's read in chefy_read, broken down by food. Each food comes back with its own lines: how to cook it, what to use if you run out, and what it pairs with. A closing note names the cart's biggest gap and its carbon and water. Every line comes from Foodbe's stored data, never from a model, so the same cart always returns the same answer. Names Foodbe does not have are listed under not_found. A limited number of calls work without a key. After that, a key is needed in the x-foodbe-key header.

items.description: The ingredient names in the cart, up to 50.
